full_details: The morning page is yours. A father names Thursday and does not ask the girl. She gets the turn, and fewer words under it. There is no dawn on the page, no cup, and no tomb. You do not copy a printed line onto it, and you hand no part out. At the Jackdaw it is fish day. Ling for the company, buttered eggs for you. The ordinary is sixpence. Richard is still in the king, and the tapster, slow with the ale, is made to bend the knee. Agnes says kings pay the same as carters, and sooner. Ralph Raye, back from the Rose side, reports a fair yard and a restless one, half of them asking the way to Shoreditch. He names no sum. Kemp says you eat like a nun and fill a house like a bear-baiting. You would rather it were like a wedding. The Shrew is at the Theatre this afternoon, and you are not in it. The Rose has a bill. You do not go. At dusk the jaw is the same jaw. You do not go to the barber.
one_sentence: You gave the girl fewer words, and heard a king pay like a carter.
title: Gave the girl fewer words, and heard kings pay like carters
